actions.title: Production OAuth identity
actions.required_owner_action: Create or select the production OAuth application, approve the hosted callback URL, and provide the required credential configuration through the approved secret channel.
actions.codex_boundary: No password-account creation, CAPTCHA handling, secret disclosure, or permission expansion.

actions.title: Stateful hosted runtime and scale budget
actions.required_owner_action: Approve a measured stateful-host and scale budget. Under the current Fly path this requires billing/payment activation and a scoped FLY_API_TOKEN; an architecture-approved free replacement must provide equivalent hosted proof.
required_scope_or_payment: Fly.io billing or approved free replacement
FLY_API_TOKEN for verify-only inventory and deployment gate
actions.codex_boundary: No payment entry, billing activation, or production deployment without the Owner gate.

actions.title: GHCR publication and release promotion
actions.required_owner_action: Approve publication of the six immutable RC8 images, provide the scoped registry/repository authorization, and approve the release-candidate review gate before any promotion.
actions.codex_boundary: No registry push, main write, release promotion, or production rollout before MARKET_READY:true and the explicit Owner gate.

actions.title: Live agent and MCP writes
actions.required_owner_action: Approve the exact write-capable tools and repositories, confirm protected-branch policy and audit retention, and authorize a bounded live-write verifier.
actions.codex_boundary: Current contracts remain dry-run/read-only; Codex must not silently activate writes.

actions.title: Hosted semantic vector memory
actions.required_owner_action: Extend the Cloudflare token with Vectorize Edit for the approved account, approve the Vectorize architecture, and authorize index, embedding, roundtrip, worker, and hosted semantic-search proof.
actions.codex_boundary: Do not hand-set live_verified; the current lexical D1 proof is not semantic vector search.

actions.title: LLM Gateway live-runtime contract
actions.required_owner_action: Approve the architecture and bounded live-runtime path that replaces or extends the currently enforced dry-run response contract, while retaining the gateway-only, budget, audit, and no-direct-provider guards.
required_scope_or_payment: Architecture decision for live Gateway execution
actions.codex_boundary: The separate Cloudflare Workers AI capability proof does not authorize changing the current dry-run gateway contract or granting percentage credit.

non_claims: This manifest does not open a capability gate or increase any percentage.
Owner-granted alone is insufficient; each action still requires its named verifier and evidence artifact.
No secret value, password, token, callback credential, or payment data is contained here.
MARKET_READY remains false until every matrix cell is evidence-backed at 100 and the aggregate verifier prints MARKET_READY:true.
